cohort: 3,398,586 deliveries in Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway, and Sweden between 2000 and 2011, including 196,220 nulliparous and 188,158 multiparous women with single cephalic presentation at term, no previous cesarean section, and induced labor
finding: Advanced maternal age is associated with an increased risk of cesarean section in women undergoing labor induction, with the absolute risk being 3-5 times higher across 5-year age groups in nulliparous compared to multiparous women.
country: Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway, and Sweden
